messages:
anika-partnerships: Quick heads-up: APAC SI asked for a marketplace private-offer that bundles a 12-month software commit + 3% hardware rebate on appliances, plus an auto-renew protection (no surprise tariff drops) and a conversion credit if they exceed commit. Thoughts?

mike-sales: Ask details: single bundle SKU that displays both, 30d auto-renew protection, conversion credit up to 20% of Q1 overage as future credit. Cap rebate?

sarah-ops: Marketplace constraints: UI can show a bundle but backend needs separate SKUs (metered commit + one-time hw rebate). Sandbox blocks negative-priced line items. Auto-renew lock might need manual private-offer renewal depending on marketplace.

anika-partnerships: Options: A) bundle UI mapping to two backend SKUs + voucher for hw rebate, B) two offers + partner docs. Prefer A for UX.

josh-product: Prototype A. Example mapping:
```
bundle_sku: REDW-BNDL-APPL-12
maps_to: REDW-COMMIT-12 (metered monthly)
          REDW-HW-VOUCHER (issued after install verification)
renewal_guard: 30d, pricing change cap 5% downward without partner consent
conversion_credit: up to 20% Q1 overage -> voucher, expires 90d
```

mike-sales: Commercial guardrails: cap hw rebate $200k/account, require serials + install proof to redeem voucher. I'll draft T&Cs.

sarah-ops: Ops tasks: verify voucher flow in billing sandbox, add webhook to issue conversion vouchers. Timeline: voucher path = ~2 sprints; negative-line items = longer approvals.

marketplace-bot: private-offer-validator: Sandbox result: negative line items blocked for hw rebate. Voucher path recommended.

anika-partnerships: Good. Action items: @mike-sales draft T&Cs by Wed EOD, @sarah-ops run sandbox voucher tests, @josh-product prepare brief + mock. I'll sync with SI Tue to confirm install verification checklist. :thumbsup:
